backpack.title: Blessings
backpack.titleText: Connecting to Supernatural has granted you minor blessings, Things that makes your life easier but aren't actual 'gifts'

backpack.title: Gifts
backpack.titleText:
By harnessing the supernatural phenomena a Marked one can utilize various abilities, that we refer as 'gifts'
<i>All Gifts described are at their baseline capabilities, With practice and your own input, You can develop these abilities beyond what is described.<i>

backpack.title: True Gifts
backpack.titleText: Archetype Gifts are all arranged in a tree, and by buying all 4 abilities of a tree you may option unlock the true gift of that tree. 'True Gifts' represent the epitome of the groups of abilities it is a part of, Selecting them grants massive boost to chosen gifts of said tree. And just like regular gifts, You can further develop 'True Gifts' into a more powerful state

backpack.title: Curses
backpack.titleText: Curses are the darker, more permanent counterparts to limitations, chosen by individuals to inflict negative conditions upon themselves, All in the name to gain a few more points.

backpack.title: Limitations
backpack.titleText: Limitations are imposed by individual themselves upon their gifts, Severely crippling them to extract more points.

backpack.title: Corruption Check
backpack.titleText: How Strained is your soul? A human Soul can only handle so much corruption..

backpack.title: Supernatural
backpack.titleText: What are the entities that will be active near your residence?

backpack.title: Companions
backpack.titleText:
These will be your support, people who you may rely upon in times of crisis.
This benefit is reciprocal however, Meaning you ought to help them when needed too.

backpack.title: Path ahead
backpack.titleText: How will you carve out your way in this new, strange world?

objects.text: One day, you noticed a strange figure lurking just outside your field of vision, an unexplainable presence that loomed at the edge of your awareness. It watched you with an eerie stillness, its presence unnerving... No one else could see it, and you felt as if you were the only one aware of its existence. As days turned to weeks, its silent observation became an inescapable part of your reality, haunting you wherever you went. There was tension in the air, an unexplainable sense of foreboding that left you feeling uneasy. The thing had been watching you for days, always in the shadows, always lurking in the corner of your eye. You could feel its presence at every hour, Unmoving, Unchanging- And then one night, It moved...

The next day, the whispers came... They slivered their way into your mind, sinister voices speaking in tongues not your own. You saw shadows slithering across the walls, heard footsteps where none should be treading, and watched as objects shifted without cause. These uncanny events accompanied you, gradually intensifying. The voices silenced, the shadows retreated, and the objects returned to their rightful places. You soon have a haunting realization: 𝚢𝚘𝚞 𝚑𝚊𝚟𝚎 𝚋𝚎𝚎𝚗 𝚖𝚊𝚛𝚔𝚎𝚍 𝚋𝚢 𝚜𝚘𝚖𝚎𝚝𝚑𝚒𝚗𝚐 𝚘𝚝𝚑𝚎𝚛𝚠𝚘𝚛𝚕𝚍𝚕𝚢. rows.title: Difficulty
rows.titleText: What will be the nature of your existence?

objects.title: Standard
objects.text: You have breached the confines of your humanity, You have become a Marked One, an individual attuned to the forces beyond the realm of mortals. Bestowed with the ability to interact with the supernatural and harness its power to do your bidding. The Supernatural has become your new natural. Gain +15 Power Potential Gain +2 Evolution Potential Gain +4 Companions

objects.title: World Breaker
objects.text: You are strong.. way too strong, You alone account for 5 generations worth of Marked individuals. No marked humans will be chosen for at least next 500 years following your birth, Supernatural entities worldwide will strengthen to accommodate your presence. You are the Strongest creature that roams the planet, but this title is not without competition. Gain +40 Power Potential Gain +3 Evolution Potential Gain +2 Companions

rows.title: Origin
rows.titleText: What was the nature of the otherworldly being that marked you?

objects.title: "Divine"
objects.text: The source of your powers is an otherworldly entity that exists beyond the realms of mortal comprehension. It has marked you for unknown reasons.

objects.title: Anomalous
objects.text: Your powers stem from an incomprehensible origin, One that exists outside of what is understood by science and rationality.

objects.title: Yourself
objects.text: Your powers stem from within you, The entity you encountered was not the source of your abilities itself, but rather a manifestation of your own psyche's attempt to comprehend the changes you are experiencing.

rows.title: Perception
rows.titleText: How is your perspective of your newfound changes?

objects.title: Rejection
objects.text:
You fear what you have become, Paranoid at the supernatural events unfolding and what they may spell for you..
You reject these changes and wish to just return back to your ordinary life.

objects.title: Acceptence
objects.text:
Your powers are now a part of you whether you like it or not, Better to accept them as your new reality..
You are still in charge of your destiny, Having some powers wont change that.

objects.title: Euphoria
objects.text:
You are special, You have ascended beyond humanity, You are superior to all..
Your wholeheartedly accept these changes, You don't even wish to return back to your previous life.

rows.title: The Mark
rows.titleText: Did you underwent any new change in your being since getting marked?

objects.title: Deformity
objects.text: Your body underwent drastic changes, letting everybody know that you're no longer a regular human, Live away from people's gazes

objects.title: Markings
objects.text:
You actually developed physical markings on your body, They will glow whenever you tap into its power
Can be hidden with long enough clothing

objects.title: Subtle
objects.text: You barely changed, The most drastic change you had, is that your eye color shifted to an abnormal one alongside darkening of skin around it

objects.title: None
objects.text:
You... didn't change at all.
How peculiar, This is an extremely rare instance of such event occuring

rows.title: Origin Blessing
rows.titleText: Your origin bestows 𝐎𝐧𝐞 unique and potent boon, a gift forged from the very essence of your existence.

objects.title: Unholy Fortitude
objects.text: You have a slightly increased resistance to physical and magical damage, making you tougher in combat and harder to injure.

objects.title: Distortion Aura
objects.text: Minor technological devices might malfunction in your vicinity, giving you an edge when dealing with security systems or electronic surveillance.

objects.title: Resonance
objects.text:
When experiencing strong emotions, your powers become more potent, granting a boost.
You will be unable to use your powers for next 24 hours after this boost

objects.title: Dark Vision
objects.text: You can see clearly in complete darkness, allowing you to navigate and operate in environments where others are blind.

objects.title: Flux Adaptation
objects.text: You are less affected by environmental extremes, such as heat, cold, or radiation, and can better withstand anomalous effects.

objects.title: Resilience
objects.text: You can resist effects that would otherwise weaken or incapacitate you, such as poisons, paralytic attacks, or fear-inducing powers.

objects.title: Divine Discerning
objects.text: You can sense whenever someone utters a lie to you, This however only works when talking specifically to you.

objects.title: Detection
objects.text: You can sense the presence of other anomalies and supernatural entities within a small radius. This makes it easier to detect hidden threats.

objects.title: Calm
objects.text: You can remain calm and focused under pressure, reducing the impact of fear, stress, and emotional manipulation on your decisions and actions.

rows.title: General Blessings
rows.titleText:
These boons are available to you, Regardless of your origins.
<b> <i>Choose any four<b><i>

objects.title: Nocturnal
objects.text: You need far less sleep than a regular human, One hour nap is enough for you to last a whole night.

objects.title: You
objects.text: For one time use, You can change your vessel into one of your 'ideal' self, as long as it is within human limits.

objects.title: Finesse
objects.text: You have a greater control over your abilities than most, allowing you to restrain their output more easily.

objects.title: Unwavering Focus
objects.text: You can easily focus on tasks, boosting your productivity. However, maintaining a calm mind is crucial for accessing this skill.

objects.title: Quick Reflexes
objects.text: Your reflexes are incredibly sharp, allowing you to react quickly. Whether it's catching a falling object or dodging a sneak attack

objects.title: Optimization
objects.text: You need to eat less to sustain yourself, Able to go twice as long without any nutrition and not suffer any negative effects.

objects.title: Survival
objects.text:
No matter where in the world you are, You can survive.
You know your way around forests, Know proper hunting tactics and can even build shelters.

objects.title: Charisma
objects.text: You possess an innate charm that make people more likely to trust and follow you, Making it easier to negotiate.

objects.title: Intuitive Combat
objects.text: You have an innate talent for hand-to-hand combat, Your fighting ability is competent but not too extraordinary, So think before you pick a fight.

objects.title: Silent Step
objects.text: You are unnaturally good at stealth, You can move silently making it easier to sneak past, approach targets unnoticed.

objects.title: Navigator
objects.text: You rarely get lost and can easily find your way in both urban and wilderness settings, making you a reliable guide and explorer.

objects.title: Inheritable
objects.text:
Your gifts can be passed down to your direct offspring, What gifts they receive is random.
Their offspring wont get any gifts however.

rows.title: What are Gifts?
rows.titleText: Every Marked human displays incredible powers that we refer as 'gifts' By harnessing the supernatural phenomena a Marked one can utilize various abilities, Execution of said phenomena may differ from origin to origin but end results are almost similar. For example, psionic arms may manifest as eldritch tentacles for a 'divine' origin while it will look almost identical to one's own arms for a 'Yourself' origin.. Regardless of what Gifts you manifest, Some Abilities are inherent to all who have been marked

objects.title: Cure
objects.text:
Any Physical aliment within you gets cured naturally over a span of a few weeks, From hereditary Birth Defects to even Cancer.
This fix only displays such speed only for the first time use, After this.. Your Recovery and healing will be boosted but never to this extent ever again

objects.title: Spirit sense
objects.text:
You can now see beyond the veil and interact with the supernatural side of your own world, All of your senses are now open to them.
Allowing you to see, hear or even touch them.
Unmarked cannot observe such entities but however can still feel effect of their powers

objects.title: Filter
objects.text:
Your psyche has been modified, Allowing you to safely tap into your new powers without killing yourself on the first try.
As a Bonus, You are resistant to effects of supernatural entities..

Keyword: resistant not immune

rows.title: Archetypes
rows.titleText: Your Powers are primarily linked to one Archetype which defines the set of abilities you can harness, Most Marked humans have only one type to choose from. While You can buy all sorts of abilities, The ones that lie within your Archetype tend to be greatly stronger and natural for you to use and are cheaper for you to unlock

objects.title: Reality
objects.text: Powers that concern reality, bending the logic of The World to their will. These powers tamper with forces that should remain untouched. World is a circus, And you are its ringmaster.

objects.title: Mentalist
objects.text: Powers that concern mind, Abilities that have access to a world beyond the five senses, allowing them to tap into the core of the living and gaze upon it. World is a circus, And you control the audience.

objects.title: Self
objects.text: Powers that concern your own existence, Abilities that can bring supernatural changes via using your body as a conduit allowing superhuman feats. World is a circus, And you are the stage.

objects.title: Exotic
objects.text: Powers that defy classification, Abilities that set their wielders apart from the mundane existence, Exert their will on reality itself. World is a circus, And you are the land it stands on.

rows.title: Gifts
rows.titleText: Powers are categorized into two distinctions, 'Archetype' and 'Universal': Universal abilities are available to all to buy from, These are the more commonly found gifts, while they are overall less flexible and powerful than Archetype powers... They do provide you with some versatility in your arsenal. Archetype abilities manifest in very particular form and are closely linked to whatever type they represent, While Nothing stops you from buying powers that are from other Archetypes distinct to your own, It's generally agreed upon that it will manifest less potently for you than it would for someone who specializes in that Archetype and is a bit more expensive than normal. Gifts below are only defined at their baseline strength You have the potential to surpass these initial limits and potentially unlock even greater strength and capabilities. One peculiar feature of Archetype Gifts is that they are arranged in a tree, and by buying all 4 abilities of a tree you may option unlock the true gift of that tree.

rows.title: Reality Archetype
rows.titleText: World is a circus, And you are its ringmaster. Exert your will on reality, Command things external to you to do your bidding. Beware, While these are the most destructive abilities any Marked one can have, They are not easy to control in beginning and you must use them with caution.

objects.title: Psionic Projection
objects.text:
Generate 4 invisible arms that can reach beyond your flesh to interact with the world.
Each of these hands can lift upto your body weight and cannot go beyond 12 meters of you but can move around swiftly.

objects.title: Psionic Repel
objects.text:
Explode psionic energy from yourself to repel back everything within radius of 6 meters.
Can throw back an group of people back by a couple meters, and if used in low intensity can deflect projectiles with only minor destruction

objects.title: Psionic Blast
objects.text:
Release tremendous bursts of psionic energy as concentrated blasts.
These blasts are strong enough to throw cars across the street, Crack concrete walls, Fling yourself into air by a few stories or can be weak enough to push tin cans.

objects.title: Psionic Barrier
objects.text:
Gather your psionic energy in a single area to generate a firm barrier capable of shielding from hailing bullets and even deflect a car crashing right into you.
Shields are large enough to cover up an entire group

objects.title: True Psychokinesis
objects.text:
When all four of the psionic powers within the tree coalesce, they create the ultimate expression of psionics.
You now harness the full might of your psionic capabilities, granting you unparalleled control over physical reality within 75 meters of you. 
Within its grasp, physical objects obey your whims, Lift an entire parking yard worth of cars, barriers that can survive collapsing buildings, Crush and toss aside matter as you see fit.

objects.title: Ignis
objects.text:
Wield the flames to your own will, Not only you can control fire with enough concentration you can even generate it.
You can now tolerate intense levels of heat

objects.title: Frost
objects.text:
Wield the cold to your own will, Not only you can command the ice but even generate it around you with enough focus.
You can now tolerate intense levels of cold

objects.title: Vetra
objects.text:
Wield the lightning to your own will, Not only you can command the bolts but even create it with high enough focus.
You can now tolerate intense levels of shock

objects.title: Botany
objects.text:
Wield the green to your own will, Not only you can command existing flora but even rapidly grow it with enough direction.
You are more resistive to toxins and drugs made via flora

objects.title: True Elementalism
objects.text:
With power over all four elements at your command, you have become the avatar of nature's own wrath.
You are no longer restricted to channel one element at a time, choosing to unleash all four simultaneously, You now possess unparalleled control over your elements within 100 meters of you.
Freeze entire streets overnight, cause any city-wide blackouts, Burn hot enough to even start affecting metallic bodies or grow entire forests within days

objects.title: Fraction
objects.text:
Call upon the shadows to manifest into reality as menacing figures no larger than yourself to do your bidding.
But beware, Each summon siphons a part of your essence, weakening your abilities and straining your mind.
Limit yourself to six summons, for past that, the risks become too severe.

objects.title: Transfigure
objects.text:
Reach out with your body, and bend the very essence of inanimate objects no bigger than a car to your will, From Replication to changing dimensions of object.
While possibilities are endless, You can only direct towards a change, as such undesired changes may arise

objects.title: Eidolon
objects.text:
Reach out to the souls beyond, invoking your power to manifest them in this world once more as weak apparitions.
While they may be willing to provide you with the information you seek, the very act of their reformation sparks an unholy cry.
Be mindful, for the souls of the dead are often restless, for the dead are not meant to return from their rest.

objects.title: Animate
objects.text:
Breath life into the inert,  granting them a rudimentary level of intelligence to follow basic commands.
Though these creations cannot exceed the size of a Household Monitor, you can animate up to a dozen of them simultaneously, providing you with a swarm of minor servants at your command.

objects.title: True Genesis
objects.text:
Unleash the full extent of your soul abilities to become Ġ̴̡̡̬̟́͐̀ơ̶̧̜͕̫͔̺̈͊̆d̷̨̀͒̇̆͝ͅ
Infuse life into massive objects, molding them into monstrous forms as they come to life before your very eyes, with sentience around that of a child.
Summon an entire legion of Shadow beings and imbue with souls of departed to grant them cognitive capabilities, Convert lead into gold and gold into writhing flesh.
Transfigure even living Humans into screaming chairs if you desire, But beware.. Marked Ones are outright immune to your transfiguration.

rows.title: Mentalist Archetype
rows.titleText: World is a circus, And you control the puppets. Control the essence of others, See things no mortal can But remain cautious, For these powers can be detrimental to your psyche if used improperly and you may accidentally learn things that are better unlearned Marked Ones are naturally resistant to such abilities, But should you be a strong enough user.. You may even begin to affect them too

objects.title: Blackout
objects.text:
You can launch mental projectiles towards someone's mind, causing weaker willed humans to knock out completely while severely disorienting a high willed individual.
You can shoot out 4 such projectiles at once and need a few seconds to recharge back

objects.title: Whisper
objects.text:
You can probe a target's mind to behave in a particular way, implant ideas into their head from distances of 20 meters.
Be aware that target may recognize these as foreign thoughts and may ignore them if the suggestions are too far removed from their character.

objects.title: Induce
objects.text:
Generate a mental pulse from yourself, inflaming their hearts with rage, fear, joy or any other emotion as long as they are within 5 meters of you.
The effects wears off within 60 seconds after getting hit by the pulse.

objects.title: Rewrite
objects.text:
By physically touching someone's head, You can wipe off someone's memories for upto 5 mins about that day and make fake memories to replace the ones that were lost.
Can be used once per day per human.

objects.title: True Possesion
objects.text:
Unleash the ultimate expression of your mental prowess, You now passively affect people around you to act in your favor, merely glare at mortals to knock them out
However your ultimate power lies in your ability to overtake someone's vessel within range of 30 meters of you, When possessing someone You can freely control their body to your liking and replicate their behavior to uncanny degrees, Once you exit their vessel.. Whatever they did under your power will be perceived as their actions only.
Your true body falls into a slumber when you are possessing someone.
You cannot possess other Marked ones

objects.title: Polyglot
objects.text:
Your ability to comprehend transcends language barriers. 
By concentrating on written texts, you can effortlessly decipher their meaning, no matter the language or whether it still exists. 
With heightened focus, you can listen to spoken words of other tongues and understand their meanings, as if spoken in your native tongue.

objects.title: Telepathy
objects.text:
By focusing, you can establish telepathic communication with individuals within a 60 meter range and read into their thoughts. Skilled practitioners may even extend this connection to an entire group. 
Target's willingness to establish the connection is irrelevant, 
Though You must know the language they are thinking in.

objects.title: Psychometry
objects.text:
You possess the ability to delve into the past of any object you touch. 
Just by placing your hand on the wall of a room, you can perceive all events that have occurred within it over the past 24 hours. Moreover, if you touch a book, your sight stretches even further back in time, allowing you to glimpse events as far as 40 hours ago.

objects.title: Clairvoyance
objects.text:
By crossing your eyes, You can observe anything that happens within area of 60 meters around you as if you are physically there.
You can merely observe things not hear them and doing this for long time hurts your eyes

objects.title: True Divination
objects.text:
Uncover the secrets of the mind and glimpse the hidden truths that lay beyond. 
Your powers transcend language barriers, allowing you to connect with anyone across 300 meters and even delve into their thoughts and intentions, See any location within your city, and read the secrets of rooms by merely setting foot within.
Yet, it is your ability to see glimpses of possible futures through prophetic dreams that defines your power. However, the accuracy of them depends on how well you interpret them, leaving room for potential misinterpretation.

objects.title: Fortitude
objects.text: Your mind is an indomitable bastion, a vast ocean of potential. Your memory has become near-perfect, storing and recalling information with remarkable ease. Your wisdom far exceeds your years, and your creativity is elevated to new heights.

objects.title: Mirage
objects.text:
Cast mental illusion upon a location, Anyone who views this area will be susceptible to it.
This ability allows you to conceal damages, hide secret doors in plain sight, and manipulate perceptions as you see fit. All you need is a moment of concentration to initiate the illusion, and it will linger indefinitely. 
However, you are limited to having only one illusion active at a time.

objects.title: Somnus
objects.text:
You can, at will, venture into the depths of someone's innermost subconscious by projecting yourself into their dreams, as long as they too are in a state of sleep. Within these dreams, you possess limited influence, capable of directing the scenarios to achieve desired effects.
However this ability is bound by a 24-hour cool down

objects.title: Tech Voodoo
objects.text:
You can interact with modern technology via your powers, Focusing on radio waves allows you to tune in and hear them. 
By concentrating, you can also remotely control various tech, and with further practice, you can even shut them off entirely.

objects.title: True Integration
objects.text:
The culmination of your mastery over perception leads you to an unparalleled feat, transcending the flesh and immersing yourself in the digital domain.
Your consciousness intertwines with the circuitry and wiring, You dont control the machine... You ARE the Machine.
Alter the functioning of machines to fit your desires, reading and rewriting their data at will.
Keep in mind, Hurting the machine will in hurt you too.
And lastly, caution must be exercised, for even the most experienced Marked Ones have succumbed to madness after attempting to venture into the depths of the internet.

rows.title: Self Archetype
rows.titleText: World is a circus, And you are the stage. Bring out supernatural changes into your own vessel, Change your form to fit your desires. These powers exclusively affect your being, So you can't touch someone and make them invisible too

objects.title: Behemoth
objects.text:
You can transform yourself into a massive, colossal being, reaching heights upto 10 meters.
Become a formidable presence that towers over your surroundings. Your physical abilities, including strength, durability, and stamina, vastly increase..
However you can use this gift once every 24 hours for 30 minutes

objects.title: Regeneration
objects.text:
With a mere focus on an injury, you can accelerate the natural healing process to an incredible degree. Minor damages can be restored within minutes, and even more severe injuries such as the destruction of a limb can be reversed within a day or less.
Regeneration process may disturb those witnessing it.

objects.title: Mimic
objects.text:
Once per hour you can assume the form of anything you have witnessed in person. 
Not only you take the shape of others but also adopt the attributes of objects, like texture of a tree bark or softness of a pillow.
While you can mimic human forms, the results often look inhuman and defective and hurts a lot.

objects.title: Forge
objects.text:
You can force temporary minor mutations upon your very being to adapt to different situations. These may range from growing bone spikes for offensive attacks, to forming an exoskeleton for added defense or claws to scale walls.
Requires intense focus and causes great pain during the initial stage.

objects.title: True Biokinesis
objects.text:
Witness the pinnacle of your shapeshifting talent, Become true shapeshifter.
Assert complete authority over your own biological makeup, enabling you to manipulate your tissues, organs, and genetic structure at will. 
You can mold your body to grow to heights of 60 meters, Regenerate limbs in matter of minutes, Mimic anything with no imperfections, Grow giant claws or extend giant spider legs to scale buildings.
Permanently alter your base body to whatever you desire, Be a different person entirely.
However.. Your spiritual presence still remain same as before and can't change no matter what.

objects.title: Ethereal
objects.text:
With a mere focus, you shroud yourself in a veil, rendering yourself invisible to the naked eye for 5 minutes at a time. 
Any sound you make is diminished allowing you to walk freely.
Beware, in bright lights.. a slight distortion of light can be noticed.

objects.title: Limbo
objects.text:
With a focused thought, you are able to shift to a higher plane.
Your mind and body can exist in a quasi-dimension, allowing you to pass through walls, and any other physical objects as if they didn't exist.
But beware, You can not keep this ability active for more than 100 seconds

objects.title: Blink
objects.text:
You can instantly teleport from one point to another within a range of 100 meters.
Your body disintegrates and re materialize in the desired location. 
You must be able to see the location you want to blink to, and the longer the distance, the more tiring it is.

objects.title: Gemini
objects.text: This ability allows you to create a tulpa of yourself, which is an exact replica of you, capable of independent operation without constant input from you like "Fraction" does. All your powers are split between the two clones and damage to one results in damage of another.

objects.title: True Ascension
objects.text: Your existence powers culminates to new heights. All the powers of this tree as twice as easier for you to use, Remain invisible for 10 minutes, Teleport as far as 300 meters But the most formidable aspect of this power is to undo your death. In order to resurrect yourself, your soul taps into the life essence of all newborns within a range of 500 meters, Extracting their essence to fuel your own resurrection. No child can ever be born around the area you resurrect yourself for another 100 years. In case you die in a location without any newborns, You cannot resurrect yourself.

objects.title: Beastkin
objects.text:
Choose one Animal no smaller than a mouse and no larger than a bear, You can now shift seamlessly between human and animal form at will. 
While your mental capabilities remain intact, your physical attributes adapt to the animal's.
Any injury sustained in the animal state will transfer to your human form as well

objects.title: Gaze
objects.text:
You can perceive the auras of living beings,aura is a glowing, colorful energy field that surrounds living beings, and their appearance may change based on their emotions and conditions.
By locking onto a person's aura.. You can only see their aura but will always be able to detect it regardless of distance.

objects.title: ventriloquist
objects.text:
You have the uncanny ability to mimic voices with perfect pitch and tone. You can replicate any voice you have heard, making it virtually indistinguishable from the original.
With concentration, You can project your voice louder the farther your target runs from you.

objects.title: Terror
objects.text:
You carry an aura of terror that instills fear and discomfort in those around you, causing them to instinctively want to run away.
By focusing, you can intensify this aura and make even the bravest men scream of utter terror in your presence

objects.title: True Beast
objects.text:
Become the Apex predator, become a being of pure primal nature at will.
Your beast form takes on a more unholy look and becomes more humanoid and you can now access more animal forms, You gain physical enhancements in your beast form that puts you above any human.
You can emit a roar that can be felt by all life forms within a considerable area, Causing any animals, except those of the same species to flee in terror. 
This roar can also be used to communicate with other creatures of its kind.

rows.title: Exotic Archetype
rows.titleText: World is a circus, And you are land it stands upon. Influence the very threads of reality... with your t-thoughts? How does that even work? While 'Reality' Archetypes are the most destructive... This type is THE MOST powerful of all, It is strictly advised to not overuse these abilities for they mess with existence itself... Please.

objects.title: Levitation
objects.text:
You can control your personal spatial coordinates, granting free movement in 3D space.
Lift your body off the ground and maintaining a state of suspension in the air. You float gracefully, seemingly defying gravity, and can move through the air with ease.

objects.title: Inventory
objects.text:
You possess access to your own pocket dimension, where you can store items no larger than what you can carry. 
However, within this dimension, Stored objects age at a slightly slower rate, To retrieve your stored objects, you need only will them to appear, and they will materialize in your hands.

objects.title: Redirection
objects.text:
This ability lets you control the force of gravity within a closed room, allowing you to shift its direction at will.
Walk on walls and even on the ceiling, as if they were the floor. 
Turn a room into a disorienting and chaotic playground.

objects.title: Reach
objects.text:
Reach into any reflective surface and emerge your hand from any other reflective surface within a range of 500 meters.
However, this ability is limited to your hand, and you can only vaguely see what's on the other end of the mirror. 
You can use this power to access hidden levers, storage areas etc

objects.title: True Liminal
objects.text:
You have transcended the boundaries of the finite, Achieve the pinnacle of spatial manipulation.
All abilities of this tree are enhanced and are overall easier for you to use.. However your true power is of 'Liminality'
Should you find yourself in a closed room, You can bring out the conceptual infinity between you and the end of the room into physical reality.
In doing so, you can extend the room indefinitely, creating a surreal and mind-bending environment where the boundaries of space seem to vanish.
Good to never run into dead-ends when <b>running away from something..<b>

objects.title: Arrest
objects.text:
This gift allows you to halt the flow of time on individual objects, effectively placing them in stasis. 
When you activate this power, a target object or person is frozen in a single point of time, unable to move or change until you release the effect.
Effect remains for 2 hours before it fades off. 
Marked Ones are immune.

objects.title: Rewind
objects.text:
Reverse the flow of time on individual objects, restoring them to their previous state upto 30 hours back.
This ability can be useful for repairing broken items or reversing the effects of wear and tear, but will fail when used on living beings

objects.title: Overclock
objects.text: By focus, You enter into overclock state. When you use this gift, time appears to move at a significantly slower rate compared to your own perception. This only affects your perception, your body will move slowly but not your mind, You can think of elaborate plans in crunch time. However you need to take frequent breaks for your overclock state, otherwise it will permanently destroy your sense of time.

objects.title: Alter
objects.text:
With High concentration, You can alter the Day-Night cycle within a range of 800 meters.
You create a localized temporal anomaly, causing time to flow at a different rate within the designated area, making it appear night on a sunny day.
This ability persists for an hour and all supernatural forces are enhanced, Marked ones or not.

objects.title: True Chronos
objects.text:
The four temporal abilities of the tree coalesce into a power of true magnitude, greatly being enhanced in the process.
Rewind things back upto by 5 days, put things on a stasis for weeks on end or make it night in a radius of 1 mile..
However your ultimate gift lies in your ability to halt the flow of time itself.
By merely reciting 'Chronos' you can stop time, Every movement will cease around you all the while you can move just the same.
Do beware, Marked ones still have their consciousness active when you stop time, So any ability that can be used mentally is still on table.
Greatly strains your vessel, Highly advised to not stop time for more than 10 seconds of your perception

rows.title: Universal Gifts
rows.titleText: World is a circus, And you are the audience These Gifts are available to all Marked ones and costs equal to all, There is no difference in their strength regardless of your chosen Archetype. Due to their availability to all, These abilities are less versatile than any Archetype specific gift and pack a lot less punch in them.

objects.title: Might
objects.text:
Your physical strength has increased, putting you well above the average.
You can knock out a regular human in a single punch, or crack concrete with your fists.

objects.title: Endure
objects.text:
Your physical durability has increased, putting you well above the average.
You can fall from 3 story high places and walk away with minor scratches.

objects.title: Sprint
objects.text:
Your physical speed has increased, putting you well above the average.
You can maintain speeds rivaling a car for several minutes, Can jump twice your height with ease.

objects.title: Brains
objects.text:
Your Mental capabilities has increased, putting you well above the average.
Expect your IQ to increase up by 20%, Can perform complex equations in your mind while in a fight.

objects.title: Contort
objects.text:
Your physical flexibility has increased, putting you well above the average.
You can twist your bodies in deeply unsettling ways yet remain unharmed.

objects.title: Danger Sense
objects.text: This gift grants a split second warning, triggering a shiver of goosebumps only a second before a direct danger to your vessel materializes.

objects.title: Immortal
objects.text:
You are biologically speaking, Immortal.
While your vessel may exhibit signs of gradual aging, they will not significantly affect your overall well-being. 
You will remain as young and vital in 200 years as you are today.
Can be killed via outside means.

objects.title: Luck
objects.text:
You gain heightened luck, making you more fortunate in various situations. 
You're more likely to find loose change, roll perfect numbers on dice games, and experience subtle chances favoring you in everyday life.
The effects are less pronounced in direct combat scenarios.

objects.title: Density
objects.text:
You can alter your body's density at will, changing it with a factor of 10.
make yourself lighter than water and walk upon it, or make yourself dense enough to crack the ground by merely standing upon it.

objects.title: Miracle
objects.text:
You possess the ability to reverse damage done to other beings, including healing physical injuries like a bruised leg or restoring someone's vision.
however you can use this gift once per week.

objects.title: Mist
objects.text:
You have the ability to exhale vast amounts of mist from your mouth, which quickly spreads and covers an area of 200 meters in radius. 
This mist can serve as cover, allowing you to strike from ambush or make a swift escape unnoticed.

objects.title: Adhesion
objects.text:
You can by focus, Stick your body to any surface you touch, Allowing you climb walls, remain hidden for long and more.
The adhesion is active as long as you will it to be and doesn't tire you that much.

objects.title: Medusa
objects.text:
With prolonged direct eye contact, you can induce a paralytic state on any mortal, incapacitating them.
The paralysis can persist for several minutes and cannot be broken or interrupted by external factors.

objects.title: Canary
objects.text:
You possess the ability to unleash devastating frequencies through your screams, capable of shaking the foundation of entire houses.
But the act of emitting such intense sounds can hurt your throat if done for too long.

objects.title: Decay
objects.text:
You have the ability to bring entropy to any object or entity you touch, causing a rapid aging process. 
This leads to rust on metals, withering in plants, and flesh to rot gradually away.
Marked Ones are immune.

objects.title: Construct
objects.text:
You can form simple hard-light constructs by focusing and concentrating energies around you, ranging from blades, staff to shields and more.
While they can handle physical blows effectively, supernatural forces can damage them.

objects.title: Bullets
objects.text:
You can launch small projectile at high velocities, essentially mimicking bullets.
Though, You cannot summon these projectiles.. You have to make use of whatever you can find around you, From rocks to coins.

objects.title: Download
objects.text:
You can replicate knowledge from anyone within 2 meters of your presence, specifically related to education and intellectual pursuits.
However, It's a slow process, needs a minimum of five hours to gain an entire year's worth of knowledge.

rows.title: Drawbacks
rows.titleText:
Oh what's that? You need more potential, hmm?
Aren't you a greedy soul... 

Drawbacks are negative conditions you will inflict on yourself to generate more potential for yourself, Sever the drawback, more potential it gives.
We have two types of Drawbacks; Curses and Limitations

Drawbacks overrides Blessings and Gifts altogether, Don't try your luck.

rows.title: Curses
rows.titleText:
Curses are the darker, more permanent counterparts to limitations, chosen by individuals to inflict more potent and enduring negative conditions upon them.

<b>Once chosen, A curse becomes a permanent part of your existence.<b>

objects.title: Different
objects.text:
You cannot associate yourself with those homo sapiens, Them living their life ignorant to the supernatural around them, It confuses you.
You are your own lifeform.
You are different.

objects.title: Twisted
objects.text:
Your reflections and shadows have an unnatural twist to them, looking at it fills you with a sense of dread and unease.
Constant exposure to your distorted reflection may impact your self-image terribly.

objects.title: Negative
objects.text:
The more negative aspects of your personality have been significantly heightened.
You find yourself becoming more arrogant and cruel, perhaps even taking pleasure in causing harm or discomfort to others.

objects.title: Unrest
objects.text:
You have difficulty finding restful sleep almost every night. Even if you manage to doze off, you rarely feel refreshed when you wake up.
This will cause occasional fatigue during the day, reducing your peak performance.

objects.title: Hunger
objects.text:
Your supernatural abilities rely directly on your body's resources, drawing nutrients from you to operate.
You perpetually feel hungry and never quite satisfy your appetite, with your stomach growling constantly.
Despite not posing a genuine threat to your health, Its quite hard to simply ignore.

objects.title: Inane
objects.text:
The gifts you possess appear to have siphoned some of your intellectual capabilities in order to fuel themselves. 
You may find yourself struggling with complex tasks or problems that were once easy, and it takes you longer to understand new concepts.

objects.title: Pacifism
objects.text:
You develop a rigid moral code against using your gifts on ordinary mortals.
Although you retain the ability to defend yourself against any assaults, retaliating with offensive actions is now off-limits for you.

objects.title: Nocturnal
objects.text:
Your powers are restricted to operating only in darkness, specifically when there is no exposure to UV rays. 
If exposed to UV rays, your gifts will rapidly wane until they disappear, rendering them inaccessible as long as you remain exposed to UV.
Shelter from UV rays will trigger the restoration of them.

objects.title: Obvious
objects.text:
When using your gifts, you are unable to do so discreetly or subtly, You will be really obvious about it.
Regular Marked Ones can often deploy their gifts unnoticed but not you, You will have a tell-tale sign.
Your enemies may take advantage of this.

objects.title: Frail
objects.text:
Your body possesses an innate weakness that makes you more susceptible to illnesses and general frailty.
Despite having gifts to bypass that, You can get sick and will occasionally have bouts of weakness.

objects.title: Slow Start
objects.text:
Your gifts will start out being notably weaker compared to the average. 
While many telekinetics can start lifting cars after a month of practice, your abilities will still only allow you to lift books at that same time.
This curse will eventually fade after a year, with your progress aligning more closely with the norm.
Don't Die till then.

objects.title: Amnesia
objects.text:
You struggle to recall the decisions you've made.
You remember having special gifts and may even have inklings of which archetype they belong to, but the specifics are hazy or completely forgotten.
Figure out everything from scratch.

objects.title: Saltic
objects.text:
You have a significant weakness in the presence of a common substance like salt.
When in the vicinity of this substance, you begin to feel weak and dizzy, and your gifts start to weaken.
Tho exposure to salt cannot never kill you, It will make the task easier.

objects.title: Uncanny
objects.text:
Beings of lower sapience find your presence deeply unsettling. Animals may react aggressively towards you, either attempting to attack or fleeing in fear.
Children, in particular, feel intense terror in your vicinity, often reacting by crying or flailing around in distress.

objects.title: Phobia
objects.text:
You develop an intense, irrational fear of something common or mundane, such as closed spaces, people, or certain objects. 
The fear is strong enough that it hinders your capabilities in the presence of the object or situation that triggers it.

objects.title: Heartless
objects.text:
Your empathy and overall emotional spectrum have been significantly diminished, resulting in a general apathy toward the feelings of others.
You may still experience emotions on occasion, they are often faint and fleeting, making it difficult for you to truly sympathize with others on an emotional level

objects.title: Name
objects.text:
You are cursed with a condition that forces you to obey any command given to you, triggered only when the person is aware of your full, true name.
The command cannot involve harming or causing you direct physical or psychological harm.
Can uses alias to introduce yourself.

objects.title: Aversion
objects.text:
Despite your physical appearance remaining unchanged, you are regarded as unattractive and even ugly by others. 
This perception is so strong that it makes people hesitant to approach you, However, as they get to know you better, this initial judgment may start to dissolve.

objects.title: Unstable
objects.text:
Your gifts often feel unstable and volatile, making it difficult for you to exert precise control over them. 
This forces you to work twice as hard to make progress, as you constantly have to monitor and restrain your powers from spiraling out of control.

objects.title: Dependent
objects.text:
You find yourself developing an intense addiction that you must satisfy for your powers to function effectively.
Often, these dependencies prove harmful to you, whether they are substances, activities, or behaviors that can negatively impact your health.

objects.title: Beacon
objects.text:
While many marked ones possess an aura that attracts supernatural beings, yours seems to be particularly potent.
This drawback increases the risk of facing hostile supernatural beings and may force you to constantly be on guard or seek protection

objects.title: Sleepwalker
objects.text:
While sleeping, You may act in your sleep and perform a wide range of random activities, from calmly walking on walls to destroying the neighborhood.
Moreover, these sleepwalking episodes are completely random, making it impossible to predict or control your behaviors during these hours.

objects.title: Unluck
objects.text:
You consistently encounter bad luck in various aspects of your life, lose money easily or get hit by stray bullets, Bad luck never ends.
While it may not lead to severe harm or absolute misery, the constant presence of misfortune can be incredibly frustrating.

objects.title: Ace
objects.text:
You lose all sexual desires and become infertile, making it impossible for you to have biological children. 
If you had any plans to have biological children in future, Give up on them.

objects.title: Insane
objects.text: Your mind is breaking apart.. You try to hold it yet you fail. You feel something clawing at your skin, inside your organs, in your eyes.. It hurts.. You deserve it. You scream.. It feels fake. You die... You laugh. 𐌂ዐ𐌍ህ𐌄ዪ𐌕

rows.title: Limitations
rows.titleText:
Limitations are self imposed drawbacks, By imposing these limits upon your potent gifts.. 
You willingly cripple them, all in the name of extracting a fraction of their potential to apply elsewhere.

<b>Limitations are not mere restrictions, but dark pacts made with destiny.<b>

objects.title: Migraine
objects.text: Harnessing the power of 'Psychokinesis tree' takes its toll. Each use causes a violent, stabbing headache that scales with power used. Intense training may somewhat alleviate the intensity, but the headache will remain as a constant companion.

objects.title: Emotional
objects.text: 'Psychokinetic gifts' are now intricately woven with your emotions, specifically intense ones like sadness, anger. If you ever find yourself drowning in such emotions, your powers will awaken unannounced and uncontrollably, releasing a surge of raw, volatile energy around you.

objects.title: Contrast
objects.text: Having both the 'Ignis' and 'Frost' gifts, which manipulate opposing temperatures, has wreaked havoc on your body. Your body struggles to regulate its temperature, leading to frequent fluctuations between intense sweating and shivering.

objects.title: Reanimation
objects.text: Your 'Eidolon' gift is no longer able to summon the souls of the deceased directly. To call upon their spirits, you must now find a corpse to reanimate their souls into. Once you do, the resurrected body rots at an alarming rate, decaying three times faster than normal.

objects.title: Divide
objects.text: The number of summons you can call forth with 'Fractions' has been halved, dropping to three before the negative effects become too taxing. However each summon is slightly stronger than before.

objects.title: Constant
objects.text: Your Telepathy is no longer within your conscious control, It's always on, forcing you to keep hearing foreign thoughts. Worse yet, the range of your telepathic reach has been amplified, The constant influx of thoughts and emotions will get annoying.

objects.title: Nightmare
objects.text: Previously, the 'Somnus' gift allowed you to enter someone's dreams with ease, creating no significant issues. Now each time you enter someone's dream now, you cause them to endure horrifying nightmares instead of their usual dreamscapes, while you witness a all of this.

objects.title: Memories
objects.text: You no longer have control over the memories that replace the ones you remove from your targets' minds via 'Rewrite'. The new memories filled in will drastically vary from person to person, ranging from mundane to bizarre or even disturbing.

objects.title: Reflected
objects.text: Whenever you manipulate the emotions of others via 'Induce' , those same emotions are inflicted upon you in turn. Keeping your own emotions in check becomes a constant challenge as the feelings you stir in others become mirrored within your own mind.

objects.title: Fading
objects.text: The illusions you weave with your 'Mirage' gift have gained a fickle quality. Illusions once permanent in their existence now fade away after a few hours, To maintain their presence, you must continually recast the illusion.

objects.title: Pain
objects.text: Normally, the gifts of 'Miracle' and 'Regeneration' heal without causing any pain whatsoever. Now, every use of these gifts will cause excruciating pain. You'll feel your bones splintering and painfully realigning, skin regrowing and much more.

objects.title: Flawed
objects.text: The beast you attempt to replicate via your 'Beastkin' gift has an inherent flaw. It can convincingly pass as a regular animal from a distance, but upon closer inspection, It just looks.. too human.

objects.title: Timer
objects.text: Your gifts of 'Ethereal' and 'Limbo' have lost their convenient built-in mental timer. You no longer have a precise gauge to track the remaining duration, Now, you must keep mental track of your powers or risk becoming vulnerable during critical moments.

objects.title: Unpredictable
objects.text: The mutations induced by your 'Forge' gift have slipped from your control. Instead of shaping the changes to your convenience, they now closely mirror the environment around you. Diving underwater might bring gills, but not wings to fly out of it.

objects.title: Radio
objects.text:
Your power to flawlessly mimic voices has been marred. 
While you can still flawlessly imitate inorganic sounds, the attempt to replicate voices of living beings feels..wrong, Creating an uncanny valley effect that disturbs both you and those around you.

objects.title: Propel
objects.text:
Your 'Levitation' gift no longer allows you to drift at a controlled pace, Instead, it transforms into a directional thrust, launching you in a specific direction.
While traveling through the sky remains unaffected, the ability to stay fixed in a particular spot is impossible, forcing you to constantly be on the move.

objects.title: Infested
objects.text:
Somethings infests the mirrors..
As you pass your hand into the reflective surface, you feel countless tiny worms writhing around it. While they pose no real danger, It feels uncomfortable.
More disturbingly, you'll occasionally encounter something larger brushing past your arm, leaving you questioning

objects.title: Pace
objects.text:
The objects you store within your 'Inventory' gift are no longer aging slowly.
They age and deteriorate at the same pace as they would in the physical world, even when no factors should logically cause their aging. Precious metals risk rusting, and fragile items may crumble away.

objects.title: Slowed
objects.text:
Your 'Arrest' gift can longer halt Time on objects, Instead of halting the flow of time entirely, it now retards its pace to half its regular speed. 
For every two hours that pass, objects and beings within its influence will age by just one.

objects.title: Shortened
objects.text:
Your 'Rewind' gift, which once allowed you to turn back the clock by a significant 30 hours, has been drastically reduced.
Now, objects can be reverted a maximum of only ten hours from their current state, narrowing your ability to fix damages.

rows.title: Corruption check
rows.titleText: So you must have been seeing 'Corruption' time to time throughout, What do they mean? Human soul, a vessel containing the essence of one's being, possesses a limited capacity to integrate the supernatural. Weaker abilities do not wear down the soul as much, but with the acquisition of 'True' gifts, That's when it starts getting strained... The soul can only withstand this stress for so long before reaching a critical threshold. Once exceeded, the soul suffers irreversible damage. 'Corruption' serves as a gauge of this strain, an ominous measure of how much our soul can endure before collapsing under the weight of your greed. Now, We must check how corrupted your soul is before proceeding.. Please ensure you are satisfied with your gifts before checking Dont exceed 13 corruption levels

objects.title: Unmarred
objects.text: What an intriguing observation.. Your soul bears no significant signs of corruption or stress, which is highly unusual among Marked ones. This extraordinary state of grace has allowed your gifts to develop and grow stronger when starting out, offering you a distinct advantage within the supernatural realm. Furthermore, the purity of your soul makes it challenging for supernatural entities to detect your presence, providing you with a rare degree of protection against them.

objects.title: Strained
objects.text: This state of being is quite common among the Marked Ones I saw. Exhibiting a moderate amount of stress, yet it possesses the resilience to endure it. Your gifts will manifest as they have been foretold, but your ability to strengthen them beyond their base form remains in your hands. While supernatural entities possess the means to detect your presence, their comprehension of your location is restricted to your city, being unable to perceive anything beyond that specific boundary.

objects.title: Collapsed
objects.text: Your fate has been sealed, consumed by its own greed. Your soul crossed the corruption threshold and collapsed under the immense strain. As time goes on, your grip on reality slips, Divide between hallucination and truth fading into nonexistence. The descent is slow yet inevitable, your sanity lost in the abyss of your mind. As time goes on, you will be transformed into another supernatural entity, immensely powerful, and yet so tragically restrained, compelled to suffer in an eternity.

rows.title: Purpose
rows.titleText: Ah, now you may be pondering the significance of these extraordinary gifts bestowed upon you. It's a question many have dared to ask: What is their purpose? What is the meaning behind all this?

objects.text: Your reality is teeming with supernatural entities and anomalous phenomena. These inexplicable occurrences lurk behind a veil, hidden from the eyes of the masses. A veil which has been lifted for you.. These occurrences are a direct manifestation of humanity's collective psyche, embodying specific aspects or the dying wishes of those who have passed.

Ah, supernatural entities, a rather odd lot, but undeniably powerful. Many feed on human essence, draining it through emotions, ideas, or even by consuming flesh. These creatures boast unique abilities, mirroring the source from which they arose, and they exhibit exceptional proficiency in using them, making them forces to be reckoned with.

To put it simply, you are a product of reality's defense mechanism. Every 50 years, humans with strong souls are Marked as means to maintain equilibrium against the supernatural. Your role as a Marked One is to venture into the unknown, and engage with these entities. Your presence will keep them in check, For you are the only one who can stand up against them so common people wont have to.

rows.title: The Supernatural
rows.titleText: Very well, I shall commence the selection process for the supernatural entities you are tasked with encountering and exorcising. Please choose 4 supernatural entities that you would like to be active near your residence. The List of Gifts that appear after selection corresponds to what said entity possesses. Exorcising an entity means to ensure that it no longer poses a threat to mortals, whether by confining it, preventing the means of its summoning, or outright eliminating it. Method is up to you to decide. However, remember that should you decide not to pursue these beings, know that they will continue to remain a threat, potentially targeting your loved ones or affecting you indirectly. Ignoring Hostile beings is not an option, as the consequences of their malevolence will reach you one way or another.
