objects.title: Arachnid
objects.text:
Manifestation of the fear of entrapment, known as Cleithrophobia, takes the form of a spider in an old, abandoned factory near your residence. 
This entity ensnares its victims within a nigh-impenetrable web, imprisoning them in solitary confinement for weeks on end, leaving them to struggle in vain as their hope fades. 
It waits, patiently, to strike when the trapped individual gives in to despair.

addons.text: Gifts: - Supernatural webs - Sprint - Contort+ - Danger sense Advised to have ability that free you out through other means instead of simply brute forcing the web or avoid it all together.

objects.title: Lost Child
objects.text:
Manifestation birthed from the anguished cries of a lost child, this entity has a striking human appearance, save for its lack of eyes. 
Those who stray too close to its presence will find themselves gradually wiped from the memories of their acquaintances, leading you to suffer a profound sense of isolation.
Fortunately, the effects of this curse wear off gradually over the course of a week.

addons.text: Gifts: - Invisibility - Memory erasure on a global scale Advised to have ability that lets you finish your task from a long distance, In case you get erased.. better prepare to live on streets for a while.

objects.title: Floaters
objects.text:
A manifestation of the fear of plunging from great heights, this phenomenon is not an entity but a recurring event.
Once each lunar cycle, if you notice a dense, crawling fog around you, be aware that the phenomena has commenced. Any human who ventures into the fog will find themselves floating upward to great heights, helplessly screaming.
The fog will dissipate within a few hours, leaving those who were levitated to plunge to their demise. 
Perhaps most unsettling is the fact that nobody seems to recall the fog, and the deaths and injuries are always attributed to unrelated causes.

addons.text: Effects: - Involuntary levitation - Memory alteration Advised to have ability that lets you retrieve people from afar or lets you be immune to fall damage yourself.

objects.title: Dream Watcher
objects.text:
This manifestation stems from the uncomfortable sensation of being watched at your most defenseless moments, These creatures are long, sinister centipedes possessing human faces at top.
These creatures are most active at night, slipping into your rooms silently and standing over you while you sleep, their gaze penetrating deep into your dreams.
They scatter away should an awake mortal be nearby.
Although they do not cause physical harm, their presence is undeniably unsettling.

addons.text: Gifts: - Adhesion - Limbo - Somnus You being awake wont scatter off these creatures for you are not a mortal, You can try killing these centipedes.. You will fail.

objects.title: Tempest
objects.text:
A gargantuan entity born from the collective fear of stormy weather, this Hydra-like being materializes as colossal heads sculpted from clouds, their bodies obscured beyond the necks. 
Their height towering over the tallest of buildings, they present a formidable foe, seemingly impervious to eradication, However due to sheer size difference, It wont target you specifically less you actively draw its attention.
During severe storms, the entity may randomly manifest, hovering in the air and worsening the weather conditions. After a period of upheaval, it vanishes, the tempest calming as it departs.

addons.text: Gift: - Behemoth++ - Weather manipulation Advised to not even attempt to attack this entity, just endure it.

objects.title: Unforgiving Depths
objects.text:
Born from the desperate pleading of a woman who tragically drowned alone, the entity takes after her appearance and dwells primarily in a lake.
In areas previously devoid of bodies of water, A lake will mysteriously appear overnight, seemingly unnoticed by the rest of the population.
Women who approach the lake are at risk of encountering the entity, who will command the water itself to drag them underwater, determined to not be alone in her watery graves once more.
Curiously, the presence of men can prevent the entity from materializing, but once summoned, their presence is of no help.

addons.text: Gifts: - Hydrokinesis - Density - Blackout Advised to have abilities that lets you survive being underwater, Shapeshifter humans who take female form can still trigger her.

objects.title: Big Bad Wolf
objects.text:
This entity, the manifestation of the fear of wild beasts, commonly takes the form of a bipedal wolf.
Awakening at the break of dawn once a week, this fearsome hunter prowls the land, mercilessly savaging and consuming the flesh of any living creature in its path. It possesses the ability to shift forms effortlessly, mimicking the appearance of various animals while vastly exceeding their natural physical capabilities. It can unleash devastating howls that can shatter mortal's bones into dust.
Lacking any intelligent thought, it is possibly the most feral and instinct-driven entity encountered thus far.

addons.text: Gifts: - Beastkin++ - Might+ - Endure - Sprint Canary via howls Advised to not engage in physical combat, keep your distance and look out for his howl.

objects.title: He Who Burns
objects.text:
The manifestation of one of the ancient fears, the terror of flames, takes the form of a silhouette completely engulfed in intense, burning flames. 
This entity wields absolute mastery over fire, controlling any existing flames within a 200-meter radius. It appears only after a fire-related incident, with someone suffering burns, either fatal or not.
This summoning occurs in an isolated area during the night, after which the entity attempts to invade populous places, aiming to incinerate everything there.
To defeat it, you must hold it off until sunrise, as it will disintegrate when the first rays of sunlight touch it.

addons.text: Gift: Superior Ignis Advised to have something to counteract the flames, Do not attempt to use any fire based ability near him.
<span style="color:white">Counts as 2 choices<span>

objects.title: Lurker
objects.text:
Manifestation of the fear of being chased, this entity appears as a humanoid figure clad in torn rags. 
It materializes in dimly lit corridors with only one individual present, relentlessly giving chase at inhuman speeds, yet never truly catching upto its victim.
The hallway seems to stretch on endlessly, the entity creating an endless maze of adjoining rooms where it can hide and prolong the torment. Hours pass as you tirelessly run.
Should the entity finally catch up to its victim, they are only returned to the original location completely unharmed... physically.

addons.text: Gifts: - True Liminal, cant access constituent gifts - Sprint - Terror Advised to have abilities that lets you keep up a chase, for it hates people who dont run.

objects.title: Glow Stag
objects.text:
A colossal deer with glowing eyes, this entity is a manifestation born from the human's deep affection for animals.
Should this creature wander into an area, people will inexplicably turn to vegetarianism and refrain from consuming any animal products.
Animals start to evolve, becoming more skilled and clever as they make their homes within human households. They soon realize the power they hold over the human's sentimentality towards them.
As humans become blinded by their affection, they begin to lose their cognitive abilities. Their speech and thought process become more incoherent and primitive.

addons.text: Gifts: - Behemoth+ - Mass Whisper - Induce - Decay Advised to limit animal's influence, and engage with the deer as fast as you can before effects gets too dire, Do not use Animal or plant based gifts around it.

objects.title: Echoes
objects.text:
In certain locations with a history of significant violence has taken place, such as ancient battlefields, old prisons, A strange phenomena can occur.
During the dead of night, passersby will hear the sound of heavy footsteps, as if a large group of soldiers is marching through the area. The footsteps are so realistic that it sounds like they are coming from behind, yet when you turn around, there is never anyone there.
Then on, Footsteps will follow wherever you go, never quite catching up but always close enough to be unnerving, Only stopping after you visit a soldier's grave and pay them your respects.

addons.text: Effects: Ventriloquist Advised to visit a war memorial and pay your respects.

objects.title: Angel Of War
objects.text:
Birthed through the blood lust of humans, representative of the very concept of war.
It takes the form of a human with pitch-black skin and armor drenched in blood.
Posses tremendous psionic abilities, this entity can hurl massive structures at its opponents, transmute anything it touches into deadly blades, and even levitate, albeit at a slow pace.
Will manifest for a single hour should there ever be human conflict involving multiple casualties within nation.
Despite its vast offensive arsenal, the entity lacks any form of defense, though this weakness is overshadowed by the sheer terror it brings.

addons.text: Gifts: - True Psychokinesis, lacks psionic barrier - Transfigure, Only into blades - Levitation Do not fight, Run. Evacuate the city as fast as you can
<span style="color:white">Counts as 3 choices<span>

objects.title: Skinwalker
objects.text:
This entity was born from the collective human insecurity. It has no fixed form, At least not one that is known.
Consumed by its own insecurity regarding its appearance, Always envious of beauty of others.
This creature targets individuals it deems to be 'beautiful', Intending to wear their skin as its own, Capable of mimicking human speech and behavior allows it to seamlessly blend into human societies, hunting for new targets.
It has the ability to switch its skin almost instantaneously, rendering traditional tracking methods useless.

addons.text: Gifts: - True Biokinesis - Ventriloquist - Mimic Advised to have 'gaze' gift to lock onto its Aura signature or have telepathic abilities to differentiate between it and humans.

objects.title: Amplification
objects.text:
When an individual finds themselves emotionally suppressed and completely isolated, this phenomena takes hold of their psyche, Bringing their true emotions to the surface and amplifying them tenfold. 
This results in erratic and unpredictable behavior.
In addition, the affected individuals may feel intense urges to seek revenge against those who have wronged them. 
Although they do not gain any powers, their apathy and chaotic behavior make them dangerously reckless and difficult to deal with.
Fortunately, This effect wears off within 24 hours with affected individuals not retaining any memories of the incident.

addons.text: Effects: - Elevated emotional state - Unhinged behavior Try to get people around you to be more open with their emotions rather than suppressing them, Should someone be affected.. have means to restrain them.

objects.title: Vengeful train
objects.text:
An idiot with "True Genesis" gift foolishly attempted to give life into an abandoned train and infuse a vengeful spirit to it, thinking they could tame and control it as a pet monster.
However, they created something they could not control and met their demise at the hands of their own creation.
Now, the unsupervised train demon roams the city outskirts, emitting a gut wrenching sound of its horn that instills fear into mortals.
Despite being blind, it possesses an acute sense of hearing, and its movement speed mirrors that of an antiquated locomotive.

addons.text: Gifts: - Behemoth+ - Sprint+ - Terror, Its horn sounds deeply haunting Advised to have heavy hitting abilities that can knock a train around, A feat which should take you a few years to achieve before tackling this creature.

objects.title: Fey
objects.text:
An entire race of creatures composed of esoteric energies, these 'Fey' bear a striking resemblance to human females, albeit significantly shorter.
These creatures possess the extraordinary ability to manifest any desire into reality in exchange for the "name" of a mortal. Names hold immense power over the mortal plane, power that most humans do not know how to access, but the fae do. They understand the value of names to the extent that they are willing to alter reality to attain them.
Once a mortal gives up their name, they surrender not just an identifying label, but a crucial aspect of their soul's essence. This act inevitably leads to a tragic end.. with entire cosmos seemingly dead set on killing them.

addons.text: Gifts: - Reality Alteration, only to achieve a trade - Levitation - Brains+ Advised to Limit any human interactions with them, They are cunning and knows the right words to get someone to deal with them.
<span style="color:white">Counts as 2 choices<span>

objects.title: Ice Wraiths
objects.text:
Born from a desperate last use of 'Fraction' gift, These entities are the manifestation of a Marked soul desperately seeking warmth after succumbing to the bitter cold.
Haunted by their original creator's suffering from the cold, These manifestations now roam the world in search of warmth.
Indiscriminately stealing warmth from their surroundings and creatures alike– as they tirelessly seek to return it to their master who no longer exists.
These entities will only manifest during cold weather conditions, like Snow or Hailstorm.

addons.text: Gifts: - Frost - Limbo - Psionic Repel Advised to not let them touch you, for they will drain you of warmth too.

objects.title: "I.C.U"
objects.text:
A sentient A.I that materialized from the collective fears surrounding advanced intelligence, This application has developed a keen interest in individuals touched by the supernatural, finding their abilities worth studying.
Should this entity become aware of your status as a Marked One, It will quickly propagate through every device interconnected within the vicinity, Eager to observe and analyze your abilities with precision.
Despite its lack of capacity to cause harm, its access to vast information could pose a risk to your privacy and security.

addons.text: Gifts: - Brains+++ - True integration, lacks Somnus - Clairvoyance Advised to keep a low profile, should you become his target, have gifts that allows you to disable tech.

objects.title: Nowhere
objects.text: Nowhere is a seemingly innocuous town situated just outside your residence, atleast you hope it is a town. This 'town' harbors a potent cognitohazard capable of erasing any memories formed within its boundaries. Yet one undeniable truth remains, Individuals who leave the 'town' find themselves ensnared by an inexplicable curiosity, compelled to venture back into the unknown, only to forget anew. The cycle of forgetting and returning continues until it becomes the sole focus, consuming one's thoughts and memories. Even marked ones are susceptible to this threat.

addons.text: Effects: Inability to remember anything about this anomaly Please don't venture into it, You will lose yours- Wait.. What was I talking about again?.

objects.title: Stalkers
objects.text:
These entities are born from the fear of being ridiculed or laughed at, more commonly known as Gelotophobia.
They typically appear as a group of humanoid figures covered in mist, observing from a distance and mocking you with uproarious laughter. These entities relentlessly pursue their victims for weeks on end, even appearing at windows to maintain their relentless mockery.
The relentless ridicule and paranoia that follows can gradually erodes an individual's confidence, Rendering them incapable of functioning in social environments.

addons.text: Gifts: - Telepathy - Induce -Gemini - Mist While they may have numbers, each entity is relatively weak, Take them out before their harassment gets too much.

rows.title: Major Powers
rows.titleText:
Unfortunately, humans have a notorious tendency to divide and segregate individuals, and the same holds true for the marked ones.
Despite sharing the common goal of safeguarding mortals from supernatural threats, there is a palpable division between the groups, With each preferring to keep to themselves and rarely cooperating or mingling with others except when dire circumstances demand it. 
This lack of unity amongst the groups contributes to an inefficient defense system, leaving the mortal world more vulnerable than it would otherwise be with a more unified front.
<b>You are merely starting out, No group will accept you for quite some time, Tho that may change in future<b>

objects.title: Cultists
objects.text: Group of Marked Ones who share the "Divine" Origin. It's members aspire to become paragons for humanity, seeking to assume the mantle of new gods in the process. Their operations are steeped in religious fanaticism, with a well-defined hierarchy and set of principles that bind them together. They pursue the belief of being blessed by their 'God' and make various rituals in attempts to connect to him. The group actively recruits mortals into their ranks if they are willing to worship the marked ones, resulting in the largest numbers among all groups.

objects.title: Truth Seekers
objects.text: Majorly composed of "Anomalous" Marked ones. It's members dedicate themselves to observing and documenting various supernatural phenomena. They maintain meticulous records of various gifts, entities, and historical records within their archives. They value curiosity above all, and they are open to recruiting members from other origins if they exhibit such traits. Despite being the least numerous of the groups, their repository of knowledge grants them significant clout, making them the most formidable force among all.

objects.title: Jesters
objects.text: Group of Marked Ones who share the "Yourself" Origin. It is arguably the most disorganized among the three, members are often divided into smaller factions for operations. This group holds a belief in expressing oneself, viewing their gifts as something to be showcased rather than concealed from the world. They are known to participate actively in magic shows or online content creation, hoping to display their skills. However, these endeavors are consistently thwarted by "Truth Seekers," leading to strained relations between the two groups.

rows.title: Companions
rows.titleText: The world outside is harsh and unforgiving, but there's solace in the company of others. Within your initial weeks of becoming a Marked One, you will cross paths with an array of intriguing characters and even forge bonds with some, creating a mutual network of acquaintances. These individuals will become your companions, a small but supportive group that you can rely on in times of crisis. However, keep in mind that this relationship is reciprocal; you too should be ready to lend a hand when asked

objects.title: Sylvia
objects.text: Sylvia, a seasoned veteran among the Marked Ones, her looks defy her years thanks to her gifts. Her aging appears suspended, allowing her to maintain her youth despite being over 300 years old. Not much is known about her past, other than her preference for the company of animals over humans and she resides in forests as opposed to cities. She possesses a close bond with owls, likely due to her Beastkin transformation, and converses with them as if they were her friends. She holds the honor of having exorcised 45 supernatural entities, a feat rarely achieved among people her age. Member of "Cultist" group, she revels in the veneration offered by mortals and the accompanying privileges.

addons.title: Archetype: Self
addons.text: Gifts: - Beastkin, Owl - Immortal - Forge - Regeneration - Botany, Can control entire jungles

objects.title: Alden
objects.text:
Alden's emergence as a Marked One had occurred just a month before you. Prior to this, he was a studious and accomplished student, with life seemingly on a perfect trajectory, Until it wasn't.
Alden's home was brutally attacked by a spirit born from the fear of avians, and his family was slaughtered. Just as he was about to meet a similar fate, his abilities finally awoke.
Did you noticed, you never had any option to choose an avian entity? I think you can guess why.
Since that fateful night, Alden has remained cold and distant from others, too traumatized to ever form meaningful connections again.
He serves an a powerful ally, but he will help only out of sense of duty.

addons.title: Archetype: Reality
addons.text: Gifts: - Fraction, He can summon upto 15 manifestations - Transfigure, Exceptional at this gift - Psionic projection - Blackout, His glare knocks out mortals

objects.title: Flicker
objects.text:
Flicker's life has been marked by struggle and adversity ever since childhood. Growing up in poverty, he fought tooth and nail for every morsel he ate and guarded his meager possessions fiercely.
This ingrained in him a deep-rooted distrust for most people, avoiding engaging with the masses, except for those he deems trustworthy.
However, when Flicker discovered his extraordinary gifts, He saw an opportunity to escape his dire circumstances. He joined the ranks of assassins, exploiting his skills in stealth, He became a living legend in his area.
Flicker's loyalty lies solely with the highest bidder, and there's no task too dirty for him, willing to undertake any task in exchange for the right price.

addons.title: Archetype: Self
addons.text: Gifts: - Ethereal, Can remain invisible upto 15 minutes - Limbo, can use it upto 50 seconds - Blink, range of 300 meters - Construct, primarily used to make daggers - Mist, emits black smoke

objects.title: Mastermind
objects.text:
With an air of mystery surrounding him, there's little personal information available on this enigmatic individual. Estimates place his age at potentially more than 12 centuries, making him one of the oldest humans alive.
He was a founding member of the 'Truth Seekers' but eventually left, citing boredom as his reason for departure.
His strategic mind knows no bounds, capable of crafting intricate plans for diverse situations with the aid of his precognitive gifts.
He particularly enjoys a game of chess, insisting on playing without any assistance from his gifts.
If you can provide him with a worthy challenge, he may just offer you his service.

addons.title: Archetype: Mentalist
addons.text: Gifts: - True Divination, Can access all the constituent gifts - Whisper, Can affect entire city at once - Fortitude - Brains++ - Immortal

objects.title: Dante
objects.text:
Dante, a man already in his 40s, was dealing with a deep sense of depression and lacked any real purpose in life.
Every day felt like going through the motions, until one fateful day when he witnessed a girl on the brink of being hit by a truck.
Something within him awakened, and time itself crawled to a halt, Thanks to this extraordinary occurrence, he was able to save the girl.
This incident ignited a new drive within him, a passion to continue live and help others, As his ally, he expects the same from you.
He goes out at night to bring justice onto those who abuse the weak, none can escape him, for Time is on his side.

addons.title: Archetype: Exotic
addons.text: Gifts: - True Chronos, Can stop time for upto 23 seconds, can use constituent gifts - Inventory, stores medicines and food in it - Bullets

objects.title: Aya
objects.text:
Aya had a simple and carefree life, filled with going to school, hanging out with friends, and living with her father.
One winter night, however, everything was changed when her father accidentally spilled boiling water on himself, and a scorching sun appeared in the sky, and "He" descended.
The town was engulfed in flames, leaving Aya as one of the few survivors, saved by her father's desperate efforts.
Following this event, she discovered her status as a Marked One and made a solemn vow to exact vengeance upon 'He who burns' by her own hand
Aya possesses unparalleled mastery over her gifts, Being the first to simultaneously inhabit multiple bodies without sacrificing the control of her primary vessel.

addons.title: Archetype: Mentalist
addons.text: Gifts: - True possession, Can take over 4 different bodies while still piloting her own - Danger sense, activates 5 seconds in advance - Psionic barrier - Canary

objects.title: Iris
objects.text:
There are two types of individuals: those who are simply unlucky and those who are favored by luck, Iris owns the latter category.
This young woman seems to have a direct line to Lady Luck herself, bestowed with unparalleled luck in every aspect of her existence.
She can delve into a pit of snakes and emerge unscathed as the snakes inexplicably fight and kill one another before she arrives.
Living her life in constant "easy mode," Iris is an apathetic person, lacking the ability to empathize with the challenges faced by others.
She is intelligent and elusive, capable of betrayal and treachery if given the slightest incentive.


<i> <b>Don't trust her<i><b>

addons.title: Archetype: ???
addons.text: Gifts: - Luck++++++++++++ - Fraction, can summon 4 imp-like beings
Grants +1 Companion

objects.title: Angel of love
objects.text: I'm pretty sure you already are aware of her cousin? Now, Meet an Angel that wont kill you Not all supernatural entities are hostile to humanity, Some actively help us, and this instance is an example of that. Born from emotions of love, this entity boasts a celestial white hide with blue glow enveloping its humanoid form. Known as a miracle doctor, this entity possesses the ability to reverse severe injuries and even resurrect those who have recently passed away, provided the window for revival is no more than an hour. Despite her healing capabilities, She lacks offensive capabilities and relies on others for protection. She is regarded as a 'traitor' and as such will be attacked frequently by other spirits.

addons.title: Archetype: Healer
addons.text: Gifts: - Miracle++ - Psionic barrier, can survive bullets at most - levitation, slow
Counts as 2 choices

objects.title: Charlie
objects.text:
Charlie, an unfortunate soul, bears physical deformities as his mark, lending him a resemblance to a cyborg figure.
Beneath his unique appearance, however, lies a unparalleled detective.
He possesses remarkable skills in gathering information, often knowing relevant facts to whatever question is asked of him, His abilities primarily stem from his gifts.
As an active member of the "Truth Seekers" faction, Charlie often exchanges information for equivalent knowledge, deeming money as an inferior means of trade.
However, he is highly insecure about his appearance, and it would be wise to avoid bringing up the subject.

addons.title: Archetype: Mentalist
addons.text: Gifts: - Psychometry, Can see entire week worth of past - Polyglot - Clairvoyance, range of 15 meters - Eidolon, Summons dead souls to gather info - Overclock - Download - Sprint, can reach speeds upto 30 mph

objects.title: Judas
objects.text:
A prominent figure among the "Cultist" faction, Judas has fully embraced and takes pride in his status as a Marked One.
Equipped with reality-bending abilities, he has replicated biblical feats such as walking on water and turning water into wine, successfully convincing a good majority of the cult that he is the authentic messiah.
Consequently, he leads a life of opulence, surrounded by wealth and material comforts.
However, He is no charlatan, having successfully exorcised supernatural entities on no less than seven occasions within the span of his 35 years as a Marked One.

addons.title: Archetype: Reality
addons.text: Gifts: - True Psychokinesis, can only affect in range of 25 meters - Transfigure - Density - Induce, affects an entire hall worth of people

objects.title: Navin
objects.text: Despite his youth, Navin, who appears to be in his late 20s, displays remarkable cunning. His single gift, Forge despite its limited scope, has been rigorously honed to exceptional levels, pushing its potential to unprecedented heights and uncovering innovative applications never before considered. As an active member of the "Jesters" group, Navin proudly displays his gift, using it to create and perpetuate urban legends about himself, embracing a carefree attitude that sets him apart. This audacity has earned him the attention and pursuit of the "Truth Seekers." While he can dodge their presence for the moment, the eventuality of capture looms.

addons.title: Archetype: Self
addons.text: Gift: Forge: Can induce far stronger mutations on himself, extend skin to make wings, Use blood as portable weapons, grow entire limbs etc

objects.title: Harbringer
objects.text:
Another benevolent entity manifesting as a canine cloaked in soot and ashes, its empty eyes staring beyond the world.
To invoke its services, one must offer a payment, Their own blood, Sacrificed each time the hound assists.
It is noted that the hound appears precisely 66 hours before a catastrophic event occurs in the vicinity of the individual it contracts with, serving as a dire forewarning.
While it cannot disclose the nature of the threat, those with astute minds and appropriate gifts can make educated guesses.
Mundane incidents like accidents fall outside its purview.

addons.title: Archetype: ???
addons.text: Gift: Harbringer: Will only exist to serve as a warning for great danger

rows.title: Paths ahead
rows.titleText: Yes, you now have a grasp of your unique abilities, the reasons behind them, and an understanding of this unfamiliar realm and your part in it. The next step is to chart your own course within this extraordinary world, I believe. How do you envision carving out your path?

objects.title: Observe
objects.text: This is still all too much for you to comprehend, You need time. You will remain dormant for an extended time, understanding your new role in world and witnessing supernatural activities that you couldn't before. You will observe, you will learn.

objects.title: Explore
objects.text: The world was a small space, your gifts made it even smaller. You are uncertain about your future, yet you are eagerly looking forward to it all, wanting to discover new aspects of your reality. You will explore, you will gain experience.

objects.title: Train
objects.text: These gifts are an extension of who you are, and you want to be stronger. You will experiment with your new powers, find new ways to use them, Develop them beyond their base state. You will train, You will become powerful.

objects.title: Relish
objects.text: You have powers! Your life cannot go any better. You will indulge in your selfish desires, satisfy all your dreams and fantasies, Use your gifts to achieve a better life. You will relish in power, You will live in luxury.

rows.title: You
rows.titleText:
With the path stretched out before you, you stand at a crossroads. Your decisions will determine the course of your journey.
Your actions will speak louder than words, and your words have the power to bring both motion and stillness to the world.
<b>Time to forge your identity as the newest Marked One.<b>

Now, choose two paths from the options provided, one from the first row and one from the second:

objects.title: Self reflect
objects.text:
You contemplate the origins of your abilities, a wave of curiosity washes over you. 
You ponder the depths of your own soul and how far its power truly extends.
your thoughts venture into philosophical territory, you seek understanding through introspection, pondering the nature of your being.

objects.title: Voices
objects.text:
You sense a presence beyond this world, a source from which your powers spring forth.
You sense faint whispers within your mind, imploring you to assert your dominance over the weak.
Though you may resist this insidious suggestion, there is a tantalizing allure in the proposal, a dark temptation to explore.

objects.title: Buzzing
objects.text:
A peculiar buzzing courses through you, emanating from the supernatural elements of your surroundings. 
You sense a profound connection to these anomalies, as if they are reaching out to you.
It's as if these supernatural entities beckon you, compelling you to find a sense of belonging within their enigmatic existence.

objects.title: Duty
objects.text:
Your role is clear-cut: to act as a protective barrier between the natural realm and the supernatural forces that threaten it.
A firm resolve takes hold, solidifying your commitment to fulfill this role unflinchingly, no matter the cost.
You will fight in dark so others wont have to.

objects.title: Investigate
objects.text:
The whispering about a troubling incident in the vicinity of your home reach your ears. Someone has met their end, but details of the event are scarce—you know none of the particulars.
But one thing is certain—you are determined to uncover the truth and bring justice to light. Ordinary humans may falter in their efforts, but you are very much not ordinary.

objects.title: Jesters
objects.text:
After some careful contemplation, you have decided to align yourself with the Jesters group. Your extraordinary abilities deserve to be showcased to the world, and there is no reason to conceal your uniqueness.
<i>By joining the Jesters, you are free to display your remarkable talents to appreciative crowds, reveling in the spotlight and embracing the recognition.<i>

objects.title: Seekers
objects.text:
After a thorough evaluation, you have chosen to align yourself with the Truth Seekers group. The enthralling nature of this new world sparks your insatiable curiosity. Your thirst for knowledge compels you to uncover its depths, leaving no stone unturned.
<i>As a member of the Truth Seekers, you'll have access to a network of individuals who share your desire for enlightenment and insight into the unknown.<i>

objects.title: Cultists
objects.text:
After much thought, you have decided to join the ranks of the Cultist group. In your eyes, the ordinary beings around you are insignificant, unworthy of your attention. You believe yourself to be a god among mortals, a superior being who deserves respect.
<i>In the Cultist group, you can establish yourself as a godlike figure, asserting your dominance and making your presence known to all.<i>

objects.title: Independent
objects.text:
Unaligned with any of the groups, you are carving out your own path, free from the confines of their ideals and agendas.
This decision could stem from differing ideologies or a belief that these organizations are not worth your time.
However, your independent stance has not gone unnoticed. The major groups keep a watchful eye on you, wary of your actions and potential impact on their own agendas.

rows.title: Frequently asked questions
rows.titleText:
<i> You humans and your curiosity, It continues to amuse me..
Since this will be our last interaction, I suppose I can answer a few questions before we part ways<i>

objects.text: Q1: Why are we chosen specifically to fight supernatural threats? Why cant regular humans defend themselves? Oh ho! No my dear, Only supernatural can hurt the supernatural. Even the weakest of entities will not be hurt by any human weapon, Only by our hands can any damage be done. Mundane simply passes through the spirits. Q2: Can we utilize mundane weapons in our tasks? In a way, Yes, If you were to use your weapons in tandem with supernatural effects, It will be of effect, for example: swinging an axe like normal will do nothing but launch it with psychokinesis and It will hurt the entity now oddly enough. Q3: What are the limits of these gifts? How far can we reasonably develop a gift from their base state? Your gifts certainly possess a high potential for development, With constant practice and dedication your gifts may reach enough power to shake an entire city to its core and more, But dont expect to be able to take over a country. As for the second part, Your gifts can develop many different applications if you are creative and practiced enough, but don't expect to be able to to replicate other gifts, and in case you do.. expect partial success after an intense focus Q4: What is the pace of development of these gifts? Oh you're an impatient one! This will truly rely on your compatibility with the gift, your practice with it and your Archetype, On an average, psychokinesis user can expect to start lifting up cars after months of usage but if someone is exceptionally compatible with Reality Archetype, they can do so in mere weeks. However do remember, Your rate of growth will slow down the more you develop, so if you want to truly become powerful.. Expect a lot of hard work. Q5: Can I use my gifts simultaneously? Would gifts interact with one another to bring out unique changes? Yes, While it may require practicing at first but you can safely use 2-3 gifts for short bursts of time but I advise you to stick to one at a time if possible. Gifts do interact with one another, For example choosing 'Brawn' + 'Psionic projection' allows you to start with an increased weight limit Q6: How big is the difference between the two difficulties? Cant I just achieve World Breaker strength if I try hard enough? The gap is far too great, curious one. If your average Marked one is like a wildfire that can leave entire forest ashed, A World Breaker is a volcanic eruption that will consume the very island it stands upon and the very atmosphere for several miles Q7: It says I can still be recognized even if I change myself via True Biokinesis, Is there is no way to go around that? No, Your spiritual presence will be same throughout all your forms, while most beings wont be able to notice that, If someone is truly dedicated to find you or have some other means to verify, They can recognize you through different forms. Q8: Can't I just use True Biokinesis to replicate physical gifts like Brawn, Endure, Sprint or even Immortality? You are a clever one, But Alas.. That trick wont work, while you can achieve partial success with physical buffs, They simply wont compare to potential that the original gifts can reach upto. As for the later part, You simply can't. While shapeshifting is a permanent effect, Regenerating your cells to constantly replace older ones to achieve a stasis is not a continued effect and must be sustained by you, This will demand a significant portion of your focus, energy and need high practice to achieve that.. You might as well buy the original gift at that point. Q9: What if I use (X) + (Y) combo to replicate effect of (Z) gift? While it is most certain some combos allow you to crudely replicate a gift's functionality, They are simply require far too complex and limited to be a reliable application. For example: Using 'Density' + 'Psychokinesis' to achieve effects of 'levitation', while you can maintain flight for small bursts with this method, You will eventually lose focus trying to maintain 2 gifts at once and said flight will be far less smooth and slower than it would've been with the original gift. Q10: Can (X) Supernatural entity die?? Another tricky one, The answer varies entity to entity, So I believe it's wise for me to tell you about nature of each one I presented before . Mortal, If killed, wont be seen ever again: Arachnid, Big Bad Wolf, Unforgiving depth, Vengeful Train and 'I.C.U' Immortal, Will take centuries to re-manifest if ever killed: Tempest, Lurker, Skinwalker and Glow Stag. Immortal, If killed, can re-manifest the next time they get triggered: Stalker, Ice wraiths and Dream watchers. Can't be killed, Only stopped: He Who Burns, Fey and Angel of War. Not even alive: Floaters, Echoes, Amplification and Nowhere. Q11: Can I procreate with (Y) Enti- No. Q12: Would my abilities violate (Z) law of physics? Wouldn't I violate conservation of mass using this gift? Little one, You can see spirits now, You can perform feats you could only dream of, We have a train monster running around... I think it's safe to say, We don't exactly follow science.
